## Package

numpy  (pip)

## Affected versions

>= 1.9.0, < 1.21

## Patched versions

1.21

## Description

A Buffer Overflow vulnerability exists in NumPy 1.9.x in the PyArray\_NewFromDescr\_int function of ctors.c when specifying arrays of large dimensions (over 32) from Python code, which could let a malicious user cause a Denial of Service. [...] The product copies an input buffer to an output buffer without verifying that the size of the input buffer is less than the size of the output buffer.  Learn more on MITRE.

### CVE ID

CVE-2021-33430
